### Controllable modes

Besides mode, target (heat and cool) and swing: eco, boost, silence,
presence/away and weekly program — the same capabilities as the Home Assistant
integration.
This integration brings Atlantic air conditioners and heat pumps controlled
by **Cozytouch** (Takao M3 and other connected Atlantic equipment) into
Gladys Assistant.

## What it does

One device per controllable room of the Cozytouch account, with: on/off
switch, mode select (off, heating, cooling, auto, fan), writable target
temperature (heating or cooling capacity follows the current mode), room
temperature sensor with history, state text, and a fan speed select
(Auto/Low/Medium/High) when the equipment exposes it.

## Prerequisites

- A Cozytouch account that works in the Atlantic app on your phone.
- Gladys Assistant 5.1 or later.

## Setup

1. Install the integration from **Integrations** in Gladys.
2. In the **Configuration** tab, enter the Cozytouch e-mail and password,
   then click **Test the connection**: the number of controllable rooms is
   shown.
3. Open the **Discovery** tab and create the rooms you want.

If a room is missing from discovery, find its numeric id (magellan deviceId
in the app's developer tools) and enter it in the “Room id” field.

The integration talks to the Atlantic Magellan cloud over the Internet, like
the official app; your credentials stay in the Gladys configuration (secret
field).

## Troubleshooting

- “0 controllable room(s) found”: check the credentials; for accounts with
  several installations, use the “Room id” field.
- The heating and cooling setpoints are a single feature in Gladys: the
  integration writes the capability matching the current mode.

Unofficial community integration, not affiliated with Groupe Atlantic.

## Parámetros de configuración

Estos son los parámetros que Atlantic Cozytouch te pide en su pantalla de configuración en Gladys.

| Parámetro | Tipo | Obligatorio | Descripción |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Getting started | `section` | No | Use the e-mail and password of your Cozytouch account (the same as the Atlantic Cozytouch app). The integration talks to the Atlantic Magellan cloud, exactly like the official app. Unofficial integration, no affiliation with Atlantic. |
| Cozytouch e-mail | `string` | Sí |  |
| Cozytouch password | `secret` | Sí |  |
| Room id (optional) | `number` | No | Leave empty for automatic discovery. If a room is missing, find its numeric id in the Cozytouch app (magellan deviceId) and enter it here. |
| Labels language | `select` | No |  |
| Refresh interval (s) | `number` | No | How often the rooms are read, in seconds (one minute minimum, to stay courteous with the Atlantic cloud). |

## Cómo instalar Atlantic Cozytouch en Gladys

1. En Gladys, abre **Integraciones**: Atlantic Cozytouch aparece en el catálogo junto a las integraciones nativas, con una insignia de comunidad.
2. Haz clic en **Instalar**. Gladys descarga la imagen Docker (`ghcr.io/tchoinard38/gladys-atlantic-cozytouch:1.2.0`), la ejecuta en un entorno aislado del núcleo y genera la interfaz de la integración (dispositivos, descubrimiento y configuración).
3. Abre la pantalla de **Configuración** de la integración, rellena los parámetros y guarda.
4. También puedes instalarla directamente desde la URL de su repositorio: [https://github.com/tchoinard38/gladys-atlantic-cozytouch](https://github.com/tchoinard38/gladys-atlantic-cozytouch).

Atlantic Cozytouch requiere Gladys `>=5.1.0`. El catálogo de Gladys se actualiza cada hora, así que una nueva versión está disponible como máximo una hora después de publicarse.

¿Todavía no usas Gladys? Es gratuito y de código abierto: [sigue la guía de instalación](/es/docs/) para empezar.

## Sobre las integraciones externas

Atlantic Cozytouch es una **integración externa**: una integración comunitaria empaquetada como contenedor Docker y publicada en GitHub. Gladys la instala con un clic y la ejecuta en un entorno aislado del núcleo. La publica y mantiene [tchoinard38](https://github.com/tchoinard38), no el equipo principal de Gladys.
